dataset_licence: CC BY 4.0 as declared on Zenodo
selection_reason: Consecutive naive subjects chosen before inspecting their EEG or predictions; pilot S1 is experienced and only verifies format.

filter.scope: Only samples from epoch start through the analysis-window end; no future-trial samples. Not equivalent to causal Z15 filtering.

analysis_start_definition: 0.5 s stimulus onset + fixed 0.14 s visual-response latency, selected before scoring
decoder: Calibration-free CCA sine/cosine references; exactly the same filter, target set, trial IDs, and decoder for both montages
success_rule: Eight-channel primary mean paired accuracy gain >= 0.05 AND participant-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0. No deployment based on secondary tasks alone.
important_limitations: Wang uses vertex reference and clinical EEG amplifier, unlike Cyton ear reference and hardware; offline accuracy cannot establish device accuracy.
One cue per target per block; the four-class subset still comes from a 40-flicker display, not an actual four-flicker screen.
Zero-phase offline filtering is not board causal processing.
